simple.meaning: דּוּמִיָּה (dûwmîyâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “stillness ; adverbially, silently ; abstractly quiet , trust.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: דּוּמִיָּה (H1747) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 22:3, with occurrences in Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דּוּמִיָּה (H1747) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in דּוּמִיָּה (H1747) before moving outward to related references.

definitions.full: H1747. dumiyyah דֻּמִיָּה דּוּמִיָּה, ( Psa 65:2 ) noun feminine silence, still waiting, repose — 39:3 silence ; 62:2 still waiting, resignation (Dr § 189. 2 ; but read probably, as 62:6 , דֹּמִּי , Bi Gr Che); 65:2 id. (but Ew Che Bä and others דֹּמִיָּה is meet ? from I. ᵐ5 דָּמָה, πρέπει , see Che); 22:3 repose (from grief and tears: Jer 14:17 ).
